mintAuthority.summary: HOME is an EIP-1967 proxy pointing to Pool16. ProxyAdmin 0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f is owned by Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486, currently 3-of-5. The Safe is also the Pool16 servicer. Loan origination is lien-gated, but proxy upgrades can replace mint-critical logic without a recorded delay.

controls.label: Bacon Protocol Pan lending/mint contract
controls.capDescription: HOME supply expands only as new overcollateralized home loans are originated through a Pan; minting is tied to lien-backed loan creation rather than free issuer mint.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095802, HOME retained Pool16 implementation 0x366049d336e73cfaf39c6a933780ca4c96ea084c and ProxyAdmin 0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f. getServicerAddress() returned Safe 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486 and getSupplyableTokenAddress() returned canonical USDC. Verified borrow() requires a property lien NFT; no aggregate mint cap is disclosed by this implementation.

controls.label: HomeCoin ProxyAdmin owner (Gnosis Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095802, ProxyAdmin.owner() remained 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486. Verified code identifies GnosisSafeProxy, slot zero identifies singleton 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552, VERSION() is 1.3.0, getOwners() returns five addresses and getThreshold() is three. getModulesPaginated(0x1,10) returned no enabled modules. Guard and fallback handler were not read. The previous legacy MultiSigWallet/no-module-system description was incorrect.
